news.analysis: Did anyone really think that McCaffrey was going to pick up more than 200 yards with three touchdowns for a second straight week? Obviously, the answer is no. The star RB did produce a solid game against a typically dominant defense, though, which included his 14th overall TD of the campaign. McCaffrey also crossed the 1,000-yard mark for total offense this season on Sunday night. He remains a top-shelf fantasy asset.
news.contents: Christian McCaffrey rushed for 49 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries, adding 13 yards on two receptions in Sunday's 35-10 rout of the Vikings.

Samuel is still a major role player for the 49ers' potent attack, though. He maintains his big-play, WR3 potential going forward.
